measures: How far the citation-correctness result depends on which entailment judge is used, rather than on the system being measured.
why: Both judges clear sensitivity and specificity floors declared before either was run, and disagree on recall by more than the sampling interval around either figure. AttributionBench (arXiv:2402.15089) finds no single automatic evaluator suffices, and that evaluators are weakest on long evidence in expert domains where claims turn on numbers and dates - which is this corpus.
no_winner_is_chosen: Only the 0.80/0.80 floors were declared in advance. Selecting on balanced accuracy after seeing which judge gives the friendlier recall is the post-hoc choice the floors exist to prevent. eval/citation_gold.py adjudicates, with human labels.

calibration.built_from: gold_answer against labelled relevant / irrelevant chunks
calibration.why: A citation metric scores paraphrase, not copies. Calibrating on verbatim text puts the cut near 1.0 and rejects supported paraphrases.
